correctness.rationale: Two independent standard-library exhaustive programs reconstruct the canonical Tutte–Coxeter graph. All induced matchings have certified size distribution 45,720,5160,16920,22680,8520,720,90,10; maximum size nine has ten realizations pairwise intersecting once and covering every graph edge twice. Counting reduces possible strong six-colorings to ninety residual exact-cover instances, each with thirty-two available seven-sets, all exhaustively ruled out by two different algorithms. Both check an explicit seven-color witness on all incompatible edge pairs; proof complete for the specified finite graph.

value.rationale: This is the minimal (3,8)-cage, specifically singled out in the 2021 strong edge-coloring literature as failing six colors. The explicit tight seven-color witness resolves this natural exact benchmark for the seven-color conjectural regime, and the ten extremal induced matchings with pairwise single overlap form a complete nontrivial incidence design useful for understanding color-class packing. It is not an arbitrary slice or mere restatement of the previously known lower bound.
